notes: P04 DIMVA-X04_feature_encoder deliverable for venue dimva: evaluation/venue2027/dimva/feature_encoding.py implements the leak-safe sequence feature encoder for GovernanceTrace (RQ1). Core contract: FeatureEncoder.fit(train_events) fits ALL data-derived transforms on TRAINING data only and stores them (per-feature train median/IQR robust scaling constants plus the training reference denial rate); transform(events) applies the stored statistics read-only. transform before fit raises NOT_FITTED; fitting on holdout-tagged data (split/partition/split_tag of dev/test/holdout) raises HOLDOUT_LEAK; a refit of an already-fitted encoder is refused with HOLDOUT_LEAK (a second fit could launder non-training statistics); dev/test encodings never alter the stored stats (stats_digest before == after many transforms, asserted in tests; each row binds the digest via stats_sha256). 44 features = 22 raw + 22 normalized across five families: time gaps (7: mean/median/std/max/min inter-arrival, gap-after-denial mean, short-gap fraction vs the caller window), scope transitions (4: distinct scopes, switch rate, cross-scope denials within window, denial-followed-by-other-scope), denial-transition signatures (5: denied fraction, max/mean denial-run lengths, allowed-after-denied and denied-after-denied rates), entropy (2: Shannon bits over tool and scope distributions) and rate-adjusted counts (4: denials/events/distinct-tools per hour over the session span, plus the denial-rate ratio to the train reference). Zero-IQR training columns fall back to documented centering-only scaling (scale 1.0) instead of dividing by zero. Deterministic: pure functions, sorted iteration, no random module/clock/environment reads, floats rounded to 12 decimals; identical (state, events, window) yield byte-identical matrices and identical fits yield identical stats digests. feature_lineage() returns one record per output feature (name, family, source_fields, transform formula, fit_dependent) generated from the same registry the encoder iterates — complete by construction, asserted over every column; exactly the 22 normalized companions plus denial_rate_ratio_to_train are fit-dependent. Fail-closed leak surface: rejection reason-code-like event fields refused with EVENT_REASON_CODE_FIELD_FORBIDDEN (RQ1 masking), campaign-label fields refused with EVENT_LABEL_FIELD_FORBIDDEN, plus unknown/missing fields, bad types, non-monotonic ts, mixed actors, empty fit, invalid window and non-list inputs with stable uppercase reason codes; holdout-tagged sequences CAN be transformed (encoded) but never fitted on; empty sequences encode to an all-zero raw row. encode(events, window) provides the one-shot task-contract signature. evaluation/venue2027/dimva/test_feature_encoder.py: 40 tests — positive (fit-then-transform shape 44, JSON-serializable, determinism byte-identical, hand-computed feature values incl. entropy/rates/ratio, stats fitted-not-constants, dev/test transforms leave train stats digest untouched, lineage completeness over all 44 columns, code-level lineage independence, five families, one-shot encode) and adversarial (NOT_FITTED on transform/digest before fit; HOLDOUT_LEAK for all 9 split-tag x tag combinations; refit refusal; reason-code and label leak-surface refusals; unknown/missing/non-monotonic/mixed-actor/empty/invalid-window fail-closed).
